resources.string: andr36oid Subsystem for dArkOSen
Set up and open dArkOSen, EmulationStation and PortMaster
The subsystem runs a small dArkOSen Linux system on your console. Use EmulationStation and PortMaster to play ports. When you exit, it returns to Android cleanly.
How it works

This runs dArkOSen, and possibly other custom firmware, in a separate contained environment, a bit like Docker. Android\'s heavy background services are stopped first, so all of your open Android apps are closed while it runs. Speed should be close to running the custom firmware on its own, but it uses the andr36oid kernel, so a few things may not behave exactly as expected. Your EASYROMS partition, or the data partition if you chose not to create EASYROMS, is mounted inside the custom firmware as /roms.

Setup steps
1. Copy the image

Open the EASYROMS (games) drive on your games card. Create a folder named subsystem/darkosen/ and put the dArkOSen .img file inside it. If the image is compressed, extract it first. Choose the file below after copying it.
2. Install PortMaster
Use the official Install.Full.PortMaster.sh to install PortMaster into tools/PortMaster/ on the same card. The full installer is recommended because it works offline.
3. Add ports and play
Put ports in the ports/ folder on the same card. Open EmulationStation or PortMaster below. Exit the subsystem to return to Android.
